children: AMREP CORP. reported first-quarter 2027 results (three months ended July 31, 2026) with revenue of $6.05M and diluted earnings per share of $0.05, versus revenue of $17.85M and EPS of $0.87 in the year‑ago quarter; net income was $276K compared with $4.692M a year earlier.
Revenue: $6.05M for Q1 2027, down from $17.85M in the year‑ago quarter (−66% YoY).
Net income: $276K for Q1 2027, versus $4.692M in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted EPS: $0.05 for Q1 2027, down from $0.87 in the year‑ago quarter.
Total revenues fell 66% year over year, driven by steep declines in land and home sale volumes.
Company reduced active land development projects to prioritize growth in its homebuilding operations.
Homes sold declined to 12 from 22 year over year; 83 homes were in production with 23 under contract representing roughly $12.5M of expected revenue.
AMREP ceased landscaping services in August 2026; other revenues (HOA management, rentals and billboards) rose about 27%.
